p: land of your habitations: Into the land of Canaan.
drink offering thou shalt offer the: The liquor was so called, because it was poured on the thing that was offered.
that ye shall prepare: Every sacrifice of beasts must have their meat offering and drink offering according to this proportion.
dough for an heave offering: Which is made from the first corn you harvest.
have erred: By oversight or ignorance, read Le 4:2,13.
iniquity shall be upon him: He shall sustain the punishment of his sin.
whoring: By leaving God's commandments and following your own fantasies.
